caption: The drawing depicts a decorative metal fence or screen in front of a stone structure with rectangular and geometric motifs. The fence consists of six vertical sections, with the four central sections featuring large lyre-shaped designs composed of curved lines and ornamental elements. Each section is bordered by vertical posts, and the three posts on the left and right ends are topped with finial decorations resembling small spires. The upper part of the fence is adorned with intersecting diagonal lines and small rosettes within rectangular and triangular segments. There are smaller decorative elements, such as floral or leaf motifs, positioned on the plain surfaces between and above the lyre-shaped patterns. The fence and its decorations are outlined in black and filled with shades of tan and brown, while the architectural background, which features a stepped rectangular design with Greco-Roman patterns, is rendered in light blue-gray tones. In the bottom left corner, there is a small, square insert showing an enlarged detail of a section of the fence’s pattern, using the same color palette. The drawing has a single fine line border close to the edge, enclosing all elements.
title: Iron Gate and Fence
